clips.title: The story
paras: Mountain Den is an isolated, hollow cave tucked into the craggy hills northeast of South Gate Outpost in Dun Morogh. Uninhabited by beasts or travelers, the cavern sits quietly off the beaten track with no evident purpose or inhabitants.

Tucked away in the frigid ridges above South Gate Outpost, the Mountain Den is an unremarkable, sheltered cave carved directly into the rock face. Unlike the trogg-infested tunnels or bear dens dotting Dun Morogh, this hollow cavern remains completely vacant. There are no supplies, campfires, or hostile predators lurking inside, making it little more than a natural shelter from the biting mountain winds.
